versions.content: References from RptContainer If rptImplPolicy of a RptContainer is used the RptContainer can reference: • VariableDataPrototype – the preparation level applies to a single data item. • ArgumentDataPrototype – the preparation level applies to a single operation argument. • ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype – the preparation level applies to a single mode. • operation – the preparation level applies to all operation ArgumentDataPro- totype . • RunnableEntity – the preparation level applies to all data items / arguments accessed by the RunnableEntity . • SwComponentPrototype – the preparation level applies to all RunnableEn- tity s (and hence all accessed data items and arguments) in the software com- ponent.
